name: Daily trip counts
sql:
SELECT pickup_day, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
GROUP BY pickup_day
ORDER BY pickup_day;

name: Average distance and count by passenger count
sql:
SELECT passenger_count, AVG(distance_milli) AS avg_distance, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
GROUP BY passenger_count
ORDER BY passenger_count;

name: Total fare and count by passenger count
sql:
SELECT passenger_count, SUM(fare_cents) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
GROUP BY passenger_count
ORDER BY passenger_count;

name: Popular routes by day
sql:
SELECT pickup_day, pickup_zone, dropoff_zone, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fare_cents >= 5000 AND distance_milli >= 10000
GROUP BY pickup_day, pickup_zone, dropoff_zone
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY n DESC, pickup_day, pickup_zone, dropoff_zone
LIMIT 20;

name: Distinct destinations by day
sql:
SELECT pickup_day, COUNT(DISTINCT dropoff_zone) AS n
FROM trips
GROUP BY pickup_day
ORDER BY pickup_day;

name: Revenue from payment type 1 by passenger count
sql:
SELECT passenger_count, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 1 THEN fare_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue
FROM trips
GROUP BY passenger_count
ORDER BY passenger_count;

name: Trip count by pickup borough
sql:
SELECT z.borough, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips t
JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone = z.zone_id
GROUP BY z.borough
ORDER BY z.borough;

name: Expensive trip count by pickup borough
sql:
SELECT z.borough, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips t
JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone = z.zone_id
WHERE t.fare_cents > 2000
GROUP BY z.borough
ORDER BY z.borough;

name: Most popular routes between boroughs
sql:
SELECT p.borough, d.borough, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips t
JOIN zones p ON t.pickup_zone = p.zone_id
JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_zone = d.zone_id
GROUP BY p.borough, d.borough
ORDER BY n DESC, p.borough, d.borough
LIMIT 10;

name: Longest expensive trips
sql:
SELECT pickup_day, pickup_zone, dropoff_zone, distance_milli
FROM trips
WHERE fare_cents > 5000 AND distance_milli > 5000
ORDER BY distance_milli DESC, pickup_day, pickup_zone, dropoff_zone
LIMIT 20;
